cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Get the docker-compose file
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("grep -A5 'environment:' /opt/areloria/docker-compose.yml | head -20")
print("Env:", stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
EOF
Env:     environment:
      - NODE_ENV=production
      - PORT=3000
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "node", "-e", "fetch('http://localhost:3000/health').then(r => r.ok ? process.exit(0) : process.exit(1)).catch(() => process.exit(1))"]
      interval: 30s
--
    environment:
      - ENGINE_URL=http://arelorian-engine:3000
      - CHECK_INTERVAL=60
    networks:
      - arelorian-network
